verdict.rationale: Terminal apps can plausibly ship AI features that consume MCP servers, so this axis applies to a-Shell. The evidence pack never mentions MCP, AI agents or any tool-calling client capability. Shortcuts integration, pip and pkg installs are general extensibility, not MCP-client support, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
